name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2026-06-22, at wavelengths from 0.94 to 4.42 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
